faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PRL Telescope Operator Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the PRL Telescope Operator Trainee recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Telescope Operator Trainee post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the Telescope Operator Trainee position at the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Tech, B.Tech, or M.Sc degree in relevant scientific or engineering streams with at least 60% marks to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Telescope Operator Trainee role?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Telescope Operator Trainee position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Telescope Operator Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Skill Test followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the PRL Telescope Operator Trainee posts is entirely online.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the PRL facility located in Mount Abu, Rajasthan, with the pincode 307501.

faq.question: Q10. When is the Skill Test scheduled?
faq.answer: The Skill Test and Reporting for Verification are scheduled for 15th October 2026.
